milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to 'find' (locate/observe) iron ore blocks. The iron ore wall is a 3x3 face at spawn-relative (-1 to 1, 0-2, 3), so the center is at (0, 1, 3). The agent must navigate close enough and face toward the iron ore to demonstrate they have visually found it. Max distance of 8 blocks is generous — the sandbox preview showed the agent was within 2-3 blocks when viewing it at step 005. Facing tolerance of 60° ensures the player is actually looking toward the ore wall, not just passing by with their back turned. This rule type is preferred over position_inside_box for find/locate tasks because it models 'player can see the target'.

Uses inventory_has because mining sugar cane causes it to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. Sugar cane breaks instantly by hand (no tool required) and drops itself as a 'sugar_cane' item. The player starts with an empty inventory, so any sugar_cane in inventory must have been mined from the scene. There are 6 sugar cane blocks available (3 columns × 2 height at spawn-relative (3-5, 0-1, 5)), so min_count=1 is a relaxed and practical threshold. This rule type is the preferred choice for mine tasks per the preference order.
